entities.summary: Forced abdication of King Michael (1947), communist takeover, Gheorghiu-Dej's Stalinist era, political terror, collectivisation, the Danube-Black Sea Canal (built with political prisoner labour), and Romania's assertion of independence from the Soviet Union.
